entries.body:
## Briefing
kind: visible
title: Your site now runs on faster hosting
outcome: This week your website moved to faster hosting. It looks and works the same, with the same words and prices.

entries.title: ci: add the Deploy Astro workflow
fix(studio): pin the recreated Sanity Studio application id
ci(astro): build on Cloudflare Workers Builds, allow test hosts
feat(astro): production routes for the cutover
copy(astro): replace Vercel with Cloudflare in privacy notice and cookie banner
Cloudflare Web Analytics once a visitor accepts analytics
entries.forClient: If a visitor accepts analytics, your site now counts page views and how quickly pages load, without cookies, and the privacy page names it.

entries.title: chore(deps): clear the remaining high prod advisories so the audit job goes green
chore(astro): drop Vercel leftovers (origin allowance, CSP hosts)
fix: CSP allows only our Web Analytics beacon, so nothing runs before consent
chore(astro): drop the staging domain and test origin hosts
chore: retire the Next.js app; the repo root is now the Sanity Studio (DOM-558)
chore(astro): rebuild only through the Workers Builds deploy hook (DOM-558)
ci: run jobs on the dd-client ephemeral runners
chore(deps): upgrade sanity to 6.17.0 and @sanity/vision to 6.18.0

notes.example/site-1#51: Your contact form now works again so people can send you enquiries.
notes.example/site-1#62: Updated your privacy notice and cookie choices to show you now use Cloudflare to host the site instead of Vercel.
